item.title: Police ID man who died in apparent drowning in lower Puna
item.description: Police have identified the man who died Friday in an apparent drowning in lower Puna.

item.title: Hawaii bills would curb keiki use of phones, social media
item.description: Hawaii’s keiki could soon face tighter limits on phone use at school, social media access and interactions with artificial intelligence under bills that continue to move through the Legislature.

item.title: How Trump decided to go to war
item.description: WASHINGTON — Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel walked into the Oval Office on the morning of Feb. 11, determined to keep the American president on the path to war.

item.title: Trump signals US is prepared for long war against Iran
item.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump said Monday that the United States would continue attacking Iran for as long as it took to leave it incapable of posing a threat, an indication that an expanding war in the Middle East could continue for weeks or more.
